### List all events

`GET /events` · [docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/events/#list-all-events)

| `target_type` | query | string |  |  | one of: `issue`, `milestone`, `merge_request`, `note`, `project`, `snippet`, `user`, `wiki`, `design` |  |
| `before` | query | date (ISO 8601) |  |  |  |  |
| `after` | query | date (ISO 8601) |  |  |  |  |
| `scope` | query | string |  |  |  |  |
| `sort` | query | string |  | `desc` | one of: `asc`, `desc` |  |
| `page` | query | integer (int32) |  | `1` |  | in OpenAPI only |
| `per_page` | query | integer (int32) |  | `20` |  | in OpenAPI only |
